purpose: Immutable project-scoped handoff objects for independent development hosts. No execution, extraction, package installation or provider credentials.

body.title: optional immutable single-line UTF-8 string up to 200 bytes; omitted/empty/null means untitled; whitespace-only or control characters rejected
body.base_revision: required explicit exact source OR document revision (e.g. requirements-v1), valid identifier up to 128 bytes; not necessarily a Git SHA and never fabricated automatically

POST /v1/projects/{project}/artifacts.permissions: agent principal with write access to active project
POST /v1/projects/{project}/artifacts.idempotency: same project/author/client_id and exact canonical payload (empty title omitted) returns same artifact (200); conflicting payload 409

GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact}/content.integrity: server recomputes SHA-256 before serving; clients must also verify exact expected hash/base

compatibility: Existing rows return title=empty string. Omitted/empty titles preserve pre-title canonical request hashes and replay across migration. Nonempty title changes conflict on a reused client_id. Old clients may continue omitting title; document is an additive role. Titles are public project metadata, not filenames or trusted instructions.
read_authority: Existing project read access; owner administrative read includes archived projects. Unknown and unauthorized IDs both return 404.
lifecycle: Append-only; no per-artifact overwrite/delete API. Explicit confirmed project deletion includes its artifacts. No automatic cleanup or retention deletion.
trust: A matching content digest proves transport identity, not correctness or trusted authorship beyond the authenticated publisher. Review binds the complete ordered/canonical artifact set and exact request.
